title: Harden MeshExtractionResult topology-consuming operations
description:
Council multi-round audit confirms MeshExtractionResult intentionally remains a mutable construction DTO, but its public ComputeAngleWeightedNormals and ToUnityMesh methods assume Triangles contains a multiple-of-three set of in-range indices and Positions is internally consistent. Manually malformed data currently leaks incidental IndexOutOfRangeException or Unity mesh errors. Add one small topology validation helper used by public topology-consuming methods, preserving the current mutable construction API and not introducing a second builder abstraction.

Parent/coordination: existing utility/code-health family TSK-0094/TSK-0105; historical finding F-39.

Validation gate: focused malformed-topology tests, normal extraction regressions, runtime build, and Unity test execution before closure.
